She turns her body to provide a full 360-degree view, highlighting how the bag sits on her back and side. (6) The woman unboxes a grey half-zip sweatshirt with 'COVERNAT 08' branding. She then appears wearing the sweatshirt over her existing outfit. She performs a series of expressive poses, including crossing her arms, making a finger heart, saluting, and finally waving at the camera.
